preconditions.description: The input number must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only digits and dashes.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(str(num)) + sum(1 for i in range(1, len(str(num))) if int(str(num)[i-1]) % 2 != 0 and int(str(num)[i]) % 2 != 0)
postconditions.description: The output string has the correct length, accounting for inserted dashes between consecutive odd digits (excluding zero).

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == str(num)[i] for i in range(len(return_value)) if return_value[i] != '-')
postconditions.description: All non-dash characters in the output string match the corresponding digits in the input number.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-' for i in range(1, len(return_value)) if return_value[i] == '-' and int(str(num)[i-1]) % 2 != 0 and int(str(num)[i-1]) != 0 and int(str(num)[i]) % 2 != 0)
postconditions.description: Dashes are inserted only between two consecutive odd digits (excluding zero).
